test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'EACH' is written as '97', 'EASY' is written as '64'. How will 'ECHO' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

Sum of opposite alphabetical positional value of given word + 6.

'EACH' is written as '97'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd7997364f6dc5681c5d4d15406d5dbeccd7e2823d34765f1cc8f7448c746ec4.png] 

= (22 + 26 + 24 + 19) + 6

= 91 + 6

= 97

and

'EASY' is written as '64'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7a46164492f1ac045c5ba63c59b1110b8dee7aa1181c576c0dc1526b2eb57b5.png] 

= (22 + 26 + 8 + 2) + 6

= 58 + 6

= 64

Similarly,

'ECHO' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed175e1d575ed8a5513ec985c49f0ea45e9479fadc4f447060b856bdcec47249.png] 

**= (22 + 24 + 19 + 12) + 6**

**= 77 + 6**

**= 83**

Hence, the correct answer is **"83".**
